title: 7 Things a Godly Man Does With No Audience
caption:
7 things a godly man does when nobody's there to see it.

Humility doesn't announce itself. It's the correction he takes without a defense. The idea he lets someone else's beat, even when his got there first. The job that gets done with no name attached to it.

In humility value others above yourselves (Philippians 2:3). Not the theory. The Tuesday version, done quiet.

Save this. Then go do one of them today, exactly like it's supposed to be done: unseen.
